provenance.note: Per-layer K4 cardinality derived from the human-built 3.42bpw Coder quant, then clamped to the K4 fragments that actually exist on disk. Layers with no K4 fragment stay uniform K3 with a zero budget; membership is seeded with the lowest-id experts IN THE FRAGMENT POOL, not the lowest ids overall, so every declared K4 slot is backed by a real fragment.
provenance.circularity_warning: On these layers every available K4 fragment is also in the reference's K4 set, so the loop can only promote experts the human already chose. Live promotion there demonstrates the MECHANISM; it is not evidence of agreement with the human and must not be scored as convergence.
provenance.mtp_layer_note: layer 78 is GLM-5.2's MTP layer: present for the loader's bitrate map, all-K3, zero budget, and excluded from the decision domain because the stats collector does not bind it
